text:
ana: Quick follow-up on the quant handback RFC — ops asked for clearer SLA boundaries when we auto-downgrade to int8/4bit. Can we settle on a contract for when to trigger a downgrade vs. forcing canary?

matt: Short version: degrade only when latency SLO is threatened AND the quality hit stays within per-endpoint budget. Need explicit tie to 'quality_floor'.

ravi: Agreed. Ops also wants per-tenant opt-out and an emergency manual override. We should persist choice in profile metadata (so a customer can pin back to higher precision).

sophia: Thoughts on observable signals? We can use 95p latency + degscore moving average + regression alerts from shadow sampling.

ana: Proposal: policy proto with three gates: latency, degradation, and sampling. If latency gate trips -> try int8 first, then int4 with hysteresis. If degradation gate trips -> abort downgrade and route to fallback model.

matt: Can we see a tiny config example? helps sync with eng-runtime.

ana: paste:
```json
{
  "policy_version": "v3",
  "gates": {
    "latency_p95_ms": 250,
    "degscore_drop_pct": 2.0,
    "shadow_sample_rate": 0.02
  },
  "fallback_order": ["int8","int4"],
  "per_tenant_override": true
}
```

ravi: runtime note: we need atomic handback—if handler starts switching precision mid-request it corrupts KV cache. Keep downgrade at request boundary only.

sophia: +1. Also add 'backoff_window' so we don't flip every minute. Maybe 10m by default.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for precision-policy v3 to staging cluster at 2026-03-24T09:30Z :rocket:

matt: Open questions: how do we measure degscore quickly? Per-token confidence is noisy. Suggest shadowing with sampled golden responses and compute ngrams + embed-sim.

ana: timeline: final API contract by EOD Fri, implementation PR early next week, ops test next Wed.

sophia: I'll sketch telemetry dashboards for the three gates and a per-tenant override flag; will post a link.

ravi: If nobody objects I'll add 'kv_safe_boundary': true to the schema so loaders can block mid-request changes.

ana: Sounds good. one more: document migration path for existing policies -> v3 (fallback mapping). I'll PR docs.

matt: :thumbsup:
